newsitem.title: FRANCE: Federal Express adds Paris-Madrid feeder.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express adds Paris-Madrid feeder.

text.p: Federal Express Corp (FedEx) has launched a five-times weekly Fokker 27 feeder service between its Continental European hub at Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport and Madrid, effective September 2, a FedEx official told Reuters.
The F27 has a cargo capacity of six tonnes.
"The launch of the new F27 Paris-Madrid service is down to strong growth in Spanish import and export traffic," he said.
FedEx currently operates scheduled intra-European flights between Paris and Frankfurt, Cologne, Milan and Basle, using Boeing 727F aircraft which have a capacity of around 20 tonnes
The U.S. express distribution group also operates scheduled flights between CDG and the U.S. using DC10 and MD11 freighters.

FedEx plans to launch long-range, eastbound freighter services from Paris as part of its round-the-world express service,the official added -Air Cargo Newsroom tel:+44 171 542 7706 fax:+44 171 542 5017
